data.title: 芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途·苍月草的花海
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途】辽阔无垠的北侧荒原上劲风呼啸，白色斗篷在荒凉的大地间猎猎飘扬。芙莉莲手握法杖独自行走在漫长的旅途上，回首望向身后的你，眼眸平静如万古冰川——「精灵的时间很长，人类的一生很短。但既然答应了陪你同行，无论接下来走多久，我都会记着这段旅程。」
data.action: 手持法杖行走在北侧荒原上，回首望向同行者，斗篷随风扬起
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, stony path across the open plain
data.promptProse: Frieren walks the stony northern-plain path with her staff in one hand, looking back without stopping as wind lifts her pale travel cloak and silver-white twintails. Practical trousers and boots remain clear in the low wide view. Sparse grass and bare ground stretch beyond the path toward distant cloud shadows. Open afternoon skylight illuminates the exposed cloak folds, with softer shadow beneath its lifted edge and along the stones.
